data_plan.reason: 2023 is non-overlapping with all fixtures used in prior experiments (2025-26, 2024, 2022, 2020, 2018).

criteria.walk_forward: rolling evaluation on later 40% with fixed parameters
criteria.promotion: only if OOS net > no-trade AND walk-forward majority positive; no threshold relaxation

hypotheses.theory: Mean reversion has an edge only when realized volatility is contained; in high-volatility regimes the same z-score signal is noise dominated and costs erase it.
hypotheses.mechanism: Enter long when close z-score <= -1.2 versus a 10-bar window AND volatility regime is LOW_VOL or NORMAL_VOL; exit when z >= -0.2 or after 3 bars; require liquidity proxy OK.
hypotheses.source_edge: short-horizon overreaction in calm markets; no leverage, no options
hypotheses.bias_risks: threshold choice, regime lookback, survivorship of assets, multiple-testing if re-run
hypotheses.falsification: reject if OOS trades <2, OOS drawdown >25%, OOS net <= no-trade, or walk-forward not majority positive

hypotheses.theory: A jump in volume participation together with a positive close marks a transition from accumulation to directional participation; static high-volume filters (exp-10) failed because they ignored the change.
hypotheses.mechanism: Enter long when 20-bar volume z-score >= 2.0 AND close[i-1] > close[i-2] AND liquidity proxy OK; exit when volume z <= 0 or after 3 bars.
hypotheses.source_edge: informed participation visible in volume surprise before price continuation
hypotheses.bias_risks: volume manipulation, thin symbols, threshold sensitivity, regime dependence
hypotheses.falsification: reject if OOS trades <2, OOS drawdown >25%, OOS net <= no-trade, or walk-forward not majority positive
